#DOGE/USDT
Dogecoin (DOGE) plunged sharply on June 21 and broke below the $0.21 support. The price has rebounded off the $0.16 support but the bulls have an uphill task ahead of them. https://t.co/e5I9H0PXIk

#DOGE/USDT
Dogecoin (DOGE) had been trading close to the 20-day EMA ($0.27) for the past three days but the bulls could not push the price above it. This may have attracted profit-booking from short-term traders, pulling the price lower today. https://t.co/v73JG4Vjvc

#dogecoin  (DOGE) has proven to the world that even a project that started as a joke can gain value and notoriety in the cryptocurrency space. This phenomenon opened the door for multiple ‘meme’ cryptocurrencies to gain a foothold.

#DOGE/#USDT
#Dogecoin (#DOGE) formed an inside day candlestick pattern on July 22, indicating indecision among the bulls and the bears. The sellers are aggressively defending the overhead resistance at $0.21 but the bulls are not giving up much ground. https://t.co/TAsYkq6C0H

#DOGE/#USDT
Although bears defended the 20-day EMA ($0.20) for the past three days, the bulls did not give up much ground. This suggests that bulls were not booking profits as they were anticipating #Dogecoin’s (#DOGE) relief rally to continue. https://t.co/zXNtDeDoDu

#DOGE/#USDT
#Dogecoin (#DOGE) turned down from the downtrend line on Oct. 6 but the bears have not been able to sink the price below the 20-day EMA ($0.23), indicating buying at lower levels. https://t.co/puWO5PkfnA
